@huggingface/transformers 3.8.1 (Apache-2.0), https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
Files copied unmodified from cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@huggingface/transformers@3.8.1/dist/ (transformers.min.js, ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.mjs/.wasm = onnxruntime-web, MIT).
Used for speech-to-text (Whisper) inside the browser. Model weights are downloaded by the library from huggingface.co on first use and cached by the browser.
The library only contacts huggingface.co (model files); all code and the wasm runtime are served from this folder.
